title: A wrong value in project settings passes unnoticed
what: One typed record and one checking parser for .claude/kit.toml (all sections relay reads: [flow], [specs], [delegate], [observe], [metrics] when built), used by every reader (hooks included); unknown keys and wrong types are named. relay doctor reports them; a hook given a broken file says so instead of silently using defaults. Same for env overrides (RELAY_DELEGATE_*, RELAY_CTX_STEP). Found 27 Oct: plugins/delegate/hooks/route-guard.py:49-55 swallows every kit.toml error (except Exception: pass); route-guard.py:155-156 denies Opus for build tiers only on "deny" or unescalated "escalate", so build_tier_opus = "denny" allows Opus; typed_only = "false" (a string) is truthy (route-guard.py:150); [observe] enabled is read by no code, only log_prompts (plugins/observe/hooks/ledger.py:47); RELAY_CTX_STEP=abc crashes budget.py at import; relay_config.relay_defaults() is never called.
why: Owner, 27 Oct: "Что контролирует целостность и валидность настроек и окружения, точно ли relay doctor сейчас покрывает все или для этого есть прочие утилиты". A scout read of the code that day (verified by the front): every reader of .claude/kit.toml parses its own section ad hoc, and nothing checks keys or values. IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen): a typo can switch a guard off.
failing_case: A project with [delegate] build_tier_opus = "denny" in .claude/kit.toml: a worker started with model opus and no Escalated line is allowed, and relay doctor says nothing.
pass_cases: build_tier_opus = "deny" still denies; the default (no key) still escalates only with an Escalated line
a kit.toml with a syntax error: the route guard names the file and the error; relay doctor reports it
typed_only = "false" (string) is reported as a wrong type, not read as true
an unknown key in [observe] is reported by relay doctor

fact: Reproduced 30 Oct 2026 on master: with build_tier_opus = "denny" the route guard allowed an opus worker with no Escalated line (exit 0, no output); with "deny" it denied. relay doctor printed nothing about the key. Code: plugins/delegate/hooks/route-guard.py:172-177, reader settings() at 44-63.
Design review 30 Oct 2026 (F3), revised plan section 9: pass case 3 now reads: typed_only = "false" (text, not a boolean) is reported as a problem and the strict default true is used.

question: Should the gate stop a branch whose project settings file (.claude/kit.toml) has a mistake (an unknown key, a wrong value such as build_tier_opus = "denny")?
options: a. the gate refuses the branch and names the key
b. relay doctor and the hooks only report it
because: principle 10 and the item itself: the failing case is a typo that silently switches a guard off; a report only in doctor needs someone to remember to run it. A freshly set-up project is tested to have 0 problems, so a refusal only meets a real mistake. Owner can reverse.
